native_tools.policy: Instantiate real OMP builtin implementations inside the isolated Linux guest, not wrappers named after native tools. Restrict exactly to this toolkit plus the trusted publisher. native_tools.scope: This is the general local-compute toolkit. Internet/browser, authenticated external effects and Studio controls remain separate explicitly scoped gates, not implicitly granted by shell

computer_api.acquire: ComputerRegistry::acquire_worker_home(&mut self, computer_id: &str, ghost_id: &str, execution_id: &str, authority_epoch: u64) -> anyhow::Result<HomeManifest>
computer_api.current: ComputerRegistry::worker_home_is_current(&self, computer_id: &str, ghost_id: &str, execution_id: &str, authority_epoch: u64) -> anyhow::Result<bool>
computer_api.release: ComputerRegistry::release_worker_home(&mut self, computer_id: &str, ghost_id: &str, execution_id: &str, authority_epoch: u64) -> anyhow::Result<()>
computer_api.acquire_rules: One transaction validates exact active Ghost/computer/epoch, runtime backend configured+available and accepted shell+persistent_filesystem, safe existing manifest, non-overlapping roots, and privacy-lane admission (the home root must be exactly its public and private lanes; legacy originals fail closed with the migrate-home instruction). Atomically grant process+collect leases; no partial grant. A different active process/collect writer conflicts. Same currently active execution may replay; released/revoked execution leases cannot resurrect
computer_api.current_rules: Read-only exact active binding and both matching active leases; return false for missing/foreign/stale/revoked/released/downgraded/unavailable state and for a home root that no longer passes privacy-lane admission. Never repair or grant during a check
computer_api.release_rules: Release only the exact current Ghost/epoch/execution process+collect leases, idempotently; no foreign or future-epoch mutation. Caller must prove VM/process stopped and artifact collection settled. Unknown cleanup retains leases for explicit reconciliation
computer_api.persistence: Reuse existing registry DB and computers/<computer_id>/{home,tasks,browser-profile}; do not allocate a new home per execution or a second registry

runtime_scope.workspace: WorkerSpec.cwd must equal HomeManifest.task_snapshot_root/<lowercase sha256 of execution_id UTF-8>; create only that private execution-specific directory after the current registered home grant
runtime_scope.mounts: Only the granted workspace at /workspace and the selected registered privacy lane at /home/ghost are writable task/home mounts. HOME is exactly home_volume/public for subscription-native routes and home_volume/private for local routes — only that one lane child is mounted, never the containing home_volume root or the sibling lane. The lane is selected solely from the trusted sealed backend, never from task content; local may consume public-classified tasks but stays private. Browser profile, credential broker, other Ghost homes, host home/config/socket, registry DB and unrelated roots are never mounted. A home root carrying unclassified legacy originals is refused (acquire, currency check and mount preparation) until the operator runs `ghost computers migrate-home`; see home-privacy-lanes-v1.json. Existing immutable runtime/source/control and bounded model spool/session mounts retain their guards
runtime_scope.authority: Use one short-held parking_lot Mutex registry handle per registered runner. Acquire before spawn; recheck exact computer lease with existing execution/deadline/Host epoch on model requests and host tool effects. Never hold registry or Host locks across model, container or other subprocess I/O
runtime_scope.lifecycle: Known no-spawn failure or fully stopped VM/process with collected artifacts may release; unknown spawn/cleanup keeps the lease. Same original execution is observed/reconciled, never respawned to make a smoke pass

arguments.path: one relative path beneath the granted execution workspace

publication.effect: Descriptor-relative no-follow bounded raw byte collection from the actual native file into the existing execution-specific immutable artifact store; no JSON or UTF-8 assumption
publication.dedup: Reuse durable tool-call admission/argument digest/receipt. Same committed call returns the exact original artifact even if the source file later changes; changed payload conflicts. Never infer a prior committed artifact from a mutable file after an unknown effect
guards: detect descriptor identity/size/mtime replacement during read
verify immutable stored digest and exact producing_attempt
publication.acceptance: Producer publication/exit/success is not independent verification or Owner acceptance; existing Root verifier remains unchanged
